title: Incidental haptic sensations influence social judgments and decisions.
central_claims: Incidental weight, texture and hardness influence unrelated social judgments; heavier clipboards increase perceived candidate seriousness.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: Weight-induced candidate evaluation was significant at stage 1 but not in the completed pooled replication: r=.063, p=.125, N=599. This does not adjudicate texture and hardness effects.
